title: Annotatio III §.VIII: After Leipzig — Charles Louis Palatine’s pacific institute blocked by Dannhauer (Autor p. 335)
pass_a_gloss: For after the Leipzig Colloquy, Charles Louis the Palatine had a pacific Institute in hand, celebrated by our Author, although overturned at that time by Dannhauer’s virulent Writings, as the Author reports p. 335.
pass_b_english: After the Leipzig Colloquy, Charles Louis of the Palatinate had a pacific project in hand — one our Author celebrates —
though Dannhauer’s virulent writings then overturned it (Autor p. 335).
source_text: Post Lipsiacum enim Colloquium, Carolus Ludovicus Palatinus pacificum Institutum prae manibus habuit, Autori nostro celebratum, licèt per virulenta Danhaueri Scripta tùm temporis interversum, uti refert Autor p. 335.
